items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997

ctx.x: No, I’m actually going on the train, on Monday, with Dan Barrett to New York, and we’re going to hang out as they say, and we’re meeting Bob Barnard on Tuesday night, and then I have to fly to Europe for two or three weeks worth of gigs over there. I’ve been going to Europe every year for almost twenty years, playing with Dutch bands. There’s a couple of bands that don’t have trumpet players — Dixieland bands.
Did you ever run into Spiegle Willcox over there?
